structured.answer: I haven't decided. The only ones that sound safe are the "כספי (שקלי)" and "אג"ח ממשלות" tracks at big names like הראל, כלל and הפניקס: about 4.4% to 4.9% over 3 years, with a fee of about half a percent. I'll ask my son or the bank before I move anything.
